text: Sara: Quick check before we flip the switch on the microsegment launch — final bids, creative set, and retarget window? Going live 9am PT tomorrow. :rocket: Ben: All good on search bids. Pushed a conservative bid stack to staging, attached numbers below. Will ramp 6am PT and full at 9am. :thumbsup: Ben: Bid stack (staging snapshot): high-intent queries: CPC $1.80 -> $2.10 max mid-intent queries: CPC $0.90 -> $1.20 max brand terms: CPC $0.35 -> $0.60 retargeted display: CPM target $4.00 Lina: Creatives look ready — we swapped hero image B for variant C (less copy). Running 2 creatives per ad group. Retarget window = 14d default, should we tighten to 7d for the webinar push? Sara: Good Q. For paid -> webinar funnel I want 7d retarget for ad clickers, 14d for site visitors. Can we implement both? Tom: Yes. Can do cookie-list segmentation: - clicks -> list:webinar-7d - site-visit -> list:webinar-14d I'll add routing rules to GA and post-click pages. Sharing snippet for tracking redirect. Tom: ```html CTA ``` Jamie: Make sure UTM campaign value uses "microseg_launch_v1" not the old name, we need that for dashboards. Ben: Updated bid ramp plan: - 6:00 PT -> 30% bids - 7:30 PT -> 60% - 9:00 PT -> 100% If CPAs spike >25% vs forecast, auto-pause non-brand ad groups and drop bids by 20%. Sara: Ok. Who's owning post-launch checks at +30m and +2h? Lina: I'll take +30m. Ben can do +2h perf deep-dive. Ben: I'll watch next 3h then handoff to growth on-call. campaign-bot: Campaign draft created: https://ads.redwood.ai/campaigns/321 -- status: DRAFT -> SCHEDULED Sara: Small ask — can we rotate creative to variant D if CTR < 0.9% after 45m? Lina: Yep. I'll set rule: if CTR < 0.9% AND impressions > 2k then swap to variant D. Tom: FYI landing page load times on staging were 1.1s mobile, 0.6s desktop. Production should be similar but watch first hour. Ben: Also enabling dynamic keyword insertion for a subset of long-tail ad groups. Should help quality score. Sara: Awesome. Last thing — quality benchmark narrative for the exec deck: emphasize cost per attendee, CPL targets, and model inference-heavy demo timings. I'll draft and share. Jamie: I'll update tracking docs with final UTM mapping after Sara's draft. Sara: Brilliant. Thanks all :pray: Let's sync 8:30 PT for a 15m pre-launch.
